messages.content: is alone the same as lonely?
not always. alone can say no other person is with you. lonely can be a feeling that you want someone there or want to feel close to someone.
use you want someone there.
alone can say no one is with you. lonely can be a feeling that you want someone there or want to feel close to someone.
can i be alone and happy?
yes. you can enjoy quiet time by yourself.
can i feel lonely in a room with other people?
yes. people being near does not always mean you feel understood or close to them.
now make one sentence for each idea, in my voice.
i am alone, and i enjoy the quiet. i am with people, but i still feel lonely.
does that mean the people in the room did something wrong?
no. the sentence gives your feeling, not the whole reason for it.
say not the reason.
it gives your feeling, not the whole reason for it.
can you give a warm reply without telling me i must go out?
you can talk about the feeling here without choosing a whole plan right now.
now only give the simple meaning of alone.
no other person is with you.
write a few words i could sing on a quiet walk. make it original, not words from a real song.
one small step along the way. i can see the light of day. tree and window, road and sky. i watch the world as i go by.
can you make it less about i and more about two people walking together?
one small step along the way. we can see the light of day. tree and window, road and sky. we watch the world as we go by.
why did can see stay the same with i and we?
because there is no change to see after can in those examples. i can see and we can see both work.
say no change after can.
there is no change to see after can in those examples. i can see and we can see both work.
now make it simple sentences rather than a song.
we walk together along the road. we can see trees, a window, and the sky. we watch the world as we go.
does that say it is the same walk we took yesterday?
no. it is a made up example, not a fact about a walk you told me about.
say example.
it is a made up example, not a fact about a walk you gave me.
can you really hear me sing it from these written words?
no. written words alone do not let me hear your voice.
only give the first short line with we again.
we take one small step along the way.
write a story about a woman watching a game before trying it. she should ask questions but not have to understand every rule first.

a woman came to visit her cousin and saw a small game on the table. her cousin asked whether she wanted to play. she said she would like to watch one part first. while he played with his sister, she looked at what they did with the pieces and asked why one piece moved back. they explained the rule and showed her a simple example. she did not remember every part, but she knew enough to try. when she began to play, she made one choice and then asked about the next. the game took a little longer, but nobody needed her to know everything before the start. by the end, she could explain the first few parts herself and knew which part she still wanted to ask about.
use when she began to play and start.
when she began to play, she made one choice and asked about the next. nobody needed her to know everything before the start.
did watching make her know every answer?
no. it gave her enough to begin, and she learned more by trying and asking.
can you tell the first choice in her own voice?
i would like to watch a little first, then try when i understand the start.
what if someone learns better by trying right away?
that can be a different useful choice. this story does not make watching first a rule for everyone.
now only give a sentence about what she still did not know at the end.
she still had a question about one part of the game.
can a question left open be useful?
yes. knowing which part to ask about can be useful even before you know the answer.
can you explain whose and who is with a book?
whose book is this asks who has the book as their own. who is reading asks which person is doing the reading.
now give an example answer to each.
this book is mine. my sister is reading.
can i answer whose book is this with my sister is reading?
not to that question. it gives the person reading, not whose book it is. someone can read a book that is not their own.
say not to that question.
not to that question. it says who is reading, not whose book it is.
now make a short story where my sister reads my book.
my sister asked to read my book. i gave it to her for the afternoon, and she sat by the window reading it.
who is reading in that story?
your sister.
whose book is it?
it is your book.
if you write the answer in my voice, what changes?
my sister is reading. the book is mine.
can the same two facts have different words like my and your because of the person talking?
yes. the people and book can stay the same while the words change with the person talking.
only give the two questions again.
whose book is this? who is reading?
i said i would meet my friend at the library. now it is closed, and i want to ask if the park works instead. write a short message.
the library is closed. would the park work for our visit instead?
can you add that i am not already at the park?
i have not gone to the park yet. the library is closed, so would the park work instead?
what if she is already walking to the library?
then it may help to give the change clearly and ask before moving yourself, so you both know which place is chosen.
write it like i am waiting for her answer.
the library is closed. would the park work instead? i will wait for your answer before going there.
does there mean the library or park?
in that message, there is about the park. to make it more clear, you can use park again.
write it again with park.
the library is closed. would the park work instead? i will wait for your answer before going to the park.
now she says the park is fine but wants the door near the station. can a park have a door? i do not know if it does.
you can ask what place she is talking about rather than choose that it must be a door in the park.
write that question.
do you mean a place at the park or the library door near the station?
why is asking useful here?
because the new place detail may be about a different place, and you need to know where to meet.
my child asked why i put the book on the shelf instead of the table. i almost said because i said so, but then i told her i needed table space for work.
you gave a reason she could understand, not only an answer that closed the question.
what if i do not have time for a long explanation every time?
you can give a short reason or say you will explain later when you can. a useful answer does not always need a whole page.
can you write the short reason in my voice?
i put the book on the shelf because i need the table for work.
does that mean the child can never put a book on a table?
no. it is about your table space for work at that time, not every table or every day.
what if i want her to ask before moving my work too?
you can say that clearly: please ask before moving the things i am using for work.
can that be a request without saying she is a child who did wrong?
yes. the request can be about what to do next time, not a name for who she is.
now make both sentences together.
i need the table for work, so i put the book on the shelf. please ask before moving the things i am using for work.
what if she asks where she can draw?
then you can help choose a place for her too, if there is one. your work need and her wish to draw can both be important.
only give a kind last reply to what i first said.
it sounds like you made the reason more clear for her.
write a story about a person not knowing what they feel after a visit. no one should make them choose a feeling right away.

a woman came home after visiting an old friend. the visit had been kind, but she felt quiet and did not know why. her brother asked whether it had gone wrong. she said no, then stopped because that did not tell the whole feeling either. he asked if she wanted to talk or just sit. she chose to sit with tea for a little while. after some time, she said she was happy to have seen the friend and sad that they no longer lived near each other. her brother did not try to make her choose only one of those feelings. they talked about the good part of the visit and the hard part of saying goodbye. before bed, she wrote one sentence in her book: the visit was good, and leaving was hard. it was not every answer, but it was more clear than before.
was the brother sure at first that the visit went wrong?
he asked whether it had gone wrong. the story does not say he knew that as a fact.
why did no not tell the whole feeling?
because the visit could be good while leaving still felt hard.
now give the question he asked about talking or sitting.
would you like to talk or just sit for a while?
did sitting mean she would never talk?
no. she sat first, then spoke when she had more words for the feeling.
now only give the sentence she wrote.
the visit was good, and leaving was hard.
can a short sentence hold two different feelings?
yes. it can keep both parts without making one take away the other.
use take away.
it can keep both parts without making one take away the other.
there are five chairs and four people. each person sits on one chair. how many chairs have nobody on them?
one chair has nobody on it.
now one person leaves the room, but the chair is still there. how many empty chairs?
two chairs are empty.
can the number of chairs be the same while the number of empty chairs changes?
yes. there are still five chairs, but fewer people are sitting on them.
now someone moves one empty chair to the kitchen. how many chairs are still in the room?
four chairs are still in the room.
how many have nobody on them now?
one chair in the room is empty, because three people are still sitting there.
what if the person who left comes back and sits on it?
then all four chairs in the room have someone on them.
can you say there are now only four chairs in the whole house?
not from that. one chair is in the kitchen, so the five chairs in this story are still in the house if the kitchen is in the same house.
it is. now count chairs in the whole house from the story.
five chairs.
can you know no other chair is in a bedroom?
no. you gave five chairs to follow, not every chair in the house.
only give how many people are in the room now.
four people.
make a sentence where my sister asks a question and my brother answers.
my sister asked a question, and my brother answered it.
now change it to my brother asked and my sister answered.
my brother asked a question, and my sister answered it.
does changing sister and brother in the sentences change who did what?
yes. in these sentences, the person before asked is the one who asks, and the person before answered is the one who gives the reply.
now tell the first story in the voice of the sister.
i asked a question, and my brother answered it.
what if she says he answered me instead of it?
that can be clear too. me is the person he answered, while it is the question he answered.
can both details be in one sentence?
my brother answered my question when i asked him.
now make the question about whether he answered.
did your brother answer your question?
why answer after did?
after did in that question, use answer. answered is right in the simple past sentence without did.
can you give only the short no answer?
no, he did not.
does that tell me why he did not answer?
no. it only says he did not, not the reason.
i told my friend i wanted to read the book she gave me. now i want something else. help me say that without saying i never wanted it.
i wanted to read it before, but i would like something different now.
can i keep it kind with a thank you?
thank you for the book. i wanted to read it before, but i would like something different now.
what if saying something different sounds like the book was wrong for everyone?
you can keep it specific to you and this time: i do not feel like reading this book right now.
can you put that after thank you without a long reason?
thank you for the book. i do not feel like reading it right now.
does that say i will never read it?
no. right now keeps it about what you want now, not every later day.
use now.
right now keeps it about what you want now, not every later day.
what if i later want to read it again?
you can. changing what you want does not make the wish you had before false.
only give a sentence with before and now.
i wanted to read it before, but i want something else now.
write a story about a table used for work in the morning and dinner later. do not make one use more important than the other for every person.

a mother worked at the kitchen table in the morning while her child was at school. she had paper, a book, and a cup near the window. before lunch, she put her work in a container and moved it to a shelf. when the child came home, they used the table to look at a school picture together. later, the father brought food, and they made space for dinner. the same table had held different parts of the day. when the child asked why the paper had moved, the mother explained that she still needed it, but not on the table during the meal. after dinner, she chose to leave the work on the shelf and read in the living room. the table did not have to be for one thing only. work and dinner each had a place in the day.
can you give a short last sentence?
the table was for work in the morning and dinner later.
use work and dinner.
the table was for work in the morning and dinner later.
did moving the paper mean she had finished all her work?
no. she said she still needed the paper. putting it away for a meal did not say the task was finished.
where was the work after dinner?
on the shelf in the container.
can you tell the change in her own voice?
i put my work on the shelf so we could use the table for the meal. i still needed the paper, but not on the table then.
only give a short name for the story.
one table, different parts of the day.
that is short enough. i wanted a message i can send without changing every word.
then you can keep that message as it is.
can you say something kind without adding more messages?
i hope the words help you say what you want.
now only goodbye.
goodbye.
add a good day wish, one sentence.
goodbye, and i hope you have a good day.
